PostToolUse.description: Approved plans execute via /execution-plan (falls back if the skill is ever absent)

hooks.command: if [ -f .claude/skills/execution-plan/SKILL.md ]; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Plan approved. Execute it by invoking the /execution-plan skill (Skill tool: execution-plan), passing the approved plan as input - do NOT drive the issue/branch/PR/review loop manually. The skill owns the full delivery loop, including Codex convergence: comment @codex review after EVERY fix push, and only merge on the literal clean-verdict comment (starts with: Codex Review: Didnt find any major issues) or an explicit on-thread diminishing-returns exit. Silence is never clean.\"}}"; else echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"Plan approved. The /execution-plan skill is not present - execute the plan directly, honoring AGENTS.md (issue first, atomic commits, gates, live verification, PR, and the Codex convergence protocol: @codex review after every fix push; only the literal clean verdict or an explicit diminishing-returns exit closes the loop).\"}}"; fi
